cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Is he dead?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: He's only unconscious. An excellent shot, right in the hand.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: That's not where I was aiming.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Hey! How long are you going to sleep?

cues.speaker: Ivan
cues.en: Help! Somebody help me!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Gillian, you mustn't kill him.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: That violates the second of JUNKER's five rules.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: We need evidence that Ivan is a Snatcher.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: The shooting just now counts as self-defense, but...

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Damn it!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Let's check the bathroom. We might find that sunscreen.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Good idea.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Let's go to the bathroom, then.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: That's what it looks like.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: So Ivan's just a drug dealer. That's what he was hiding.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Ivan was using tanning oil, not sunscreen, when he went aero-surfing.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: He got that deep tan from ultraviolet rays,

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: the very thing Snatchers fear most.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Yet there was nothing wrong with his skin.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: I can't believe it's artificial.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: It seems Ivan isn't a Snatcher.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Hey! Wake up!

cues.speaker: Ivan
cues.en: I'm just a dealer. I only handle Liquid Sky. Give me a break.

cues.speaker: Ivan
cues.en: Hurry and call an ambulance!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: I'm not a cop. I'm a JUNKER!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: I don't care if you're a dealer!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: I want to know if you're human or a Snatcher!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Gillian, Ivan's skin is normal.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: With that tan and no melanoma, he's in the clear.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: HQ just sent us a scanning warrant.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Under Article 18 of the Civil Code, the Human Rights

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Protection Ordinance on Snatchers, I will now scan Ivan.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: The scan is complete. Ivan Rodriguez is entirely Homo sapiens.

cues.speaker: Ivan
cues.en: That's what I've been telling you! I'm no Snatcher!

cues.speaker: Ivan
cues.en: Get me a doctor, quick!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Try packing the wound with your drugs.

cues.speaker: Ivan
cues.en: What did I ever do to you?

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: The nice men from Narcotics are coming. They will be here soon.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Go cry to them.

cues.speaker: Ivan
cues.en: Hey! Help me! What did I do? I just love aero-surfing!

cues.speaker: Ivan
cues.en: I only wanted to win the championship! I needed money!

cues.speaker: Ivan
cues.en: They're only drugs! Even kids have them!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: So Ivan Rodriguez wasn't a Snatcher at all.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Unlucky for him. His face just happened to match.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: That leaves Freddy Nielsen.
